newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico, Britain trade seen 20 pct up this year.
newsitem.headline: Mexico, Britain trade seen 20 pct up this year.

text.p: Trade between Mexico and Britain will grow about 20 percent this year to some $1.2 billion, British ambassador Adrian Beamish said on Wednesday.

"It's difficult right now to predict what the figure will be at the end of the year, but I believe we're talking about a figure of $1.2 billion. Something like that," Beamish told journalists during a visit with Nuevo Leon governor Benjamin Clariond.
Trade between the two countries totalled $1.0 billion in 1995, but Beamish said, "This figure will grow in favour of Mexico."
He said Mexico likely would export more oil, beef, textiles and auto parts to Britain in 1996.
"Mexican exports to England have increased notably, while our exports here have not grown at the same pace," Beamish said.
